flags.why: Long nhãn is a current food ingredient sold and used in desserts, so dated and rare are misleading ([current usage](https://honglam.vn/long-nhan)).
Learners are more likely to encounter giạ as a quantity of grain than as the measuring container.
The adjective belongs mainly to literary and historical descriptions rather than ordinary casual speech ([usage](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/gian-hung-eIuOvrPJIzkpZ.html)).
Tia X means the radiation used to produce an image, not the image or scan itself ([usage](https://www.vinmec.com/vie/bai-viet/chup-x-quang-trong-tam-soat-ung-thu-vu-vi)).
flags.fix: Delete sense 2; the example would require: Bác sĩ nhìn phim X-quang và nói xương không bị gãy.

flags.why: Yếu sinh lí refers to impaired sexual function, which can include erection or ejaculation problems even without low libido ([definition](https://tamanhhospital.vn/yeu-sinh-ly-co-con-hay-khong/)).
flags.fix: yếu sinh lí = to have impaired sexual function (also humorous: to be physically weak)
